arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import math
commercial = 77688
mutual = 4206
ratio = commercial / mutual
ln_ratio = math.log(ratio)
print(f'Commercial banks: {commercial}')
print(f'Mutual savings banks: {mutual}')
print(f'Ratio: {ratio}')
print(f'ln(ratio): {ln_ratio}')
print(f'Rounded to 3 decimals: {round(ln_ratio, 3)}')
"
